{{Quote|If I stop to decrypt this&hellip; it's the shockprod.|Benx|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
The '''electroprod''' or '''shockprod''' was an electric tool. It was primarily used for herding [[Nerf/Legends|nerfs]], but when set on high voltage, it could be utilized as an instrument of [[Torture/Legends|torture]]. On the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kadril]], [[EV-series supervisor droid/Legends|EV-series supervisor droids]] tasked with supervising organic employees, utilized electroprods as a painful form of motivation.
